items.title: OpenAI Scholars 2019: Final projects
items.summary: Our second class of OpenAI Scholars has concluded, with all eight scholars producing an exciting final project showcased at Scholars Demo Day at OpenAI.
items.summaryZh: 本文总结了第二期OpenAI学者计划的最终项目成果及成果展示日活动。

aiReview.reasonZh: 文章属于2019年的人才培养项目回顾，缺乏大模型技术或产业落地的实质性内容。
